description: The shared preset's four lanes, plus two recorded overrides (also in AGENTS.md, 'Dependencies are Renovate's'). timezone: the preset's 'before 6am' windows run in the owner's day (America/Denver), as this repository's lanes did before it moved to the preset. The @isocan/** rule: the workspace packages are this repository's own source, not dependencies, so no lane may update them. Automerge stays as the preset has it: a merge to main deploys dev.isocan.io only through the green ref after CI, and isocan.io moves only on the prod tag, so a merge is not a production deploy.

packageRules.description: The project's own workspace packages (package.json workspaces and name) are source, not dependencies, so no lane turns them on. After the preset's rules, so it wins.
